blocked_rows.blocked_reason: no local CUDA device (torch cpu build); a full-length 35-epoch B08 run on the PC backend exceeds the milestone compute budget. The bounded parity protocol is executed instead and is reported as a parity result, never as a second full training result.

declared data not available at the frozen frame plan. frames_per_video is frozen at 4 (uniform-v1, m2-v1) for every split. Re-extracting SOURCE at another density would change the source package identity b1cf29b6...9dc6 and break every M8 bank lock and M9 checkpoint identity bound to it; and uniform-4 indices are not a subset of uniform-16, so a denser TARGET package would forfeit the byte-for-byte live reproduction check required by docs/M10_TARGET_DATA_CONTRACT.md section 7.3. A denser target-side v3 package is a separate, deferred decision that will not be taken on the basis of any observed target result.
